📢 TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Burin Peninsula RCMP advises that emergency crews are responding to a motor vehicle collision along Route 220 - commonly known by locals as Black Brook – between Marystown and Burin.

Motorists should expect delays and are asked to drive with extreme caution and obey all directions from first responders at the scene.

Road conditions in the area are extremely poor and deteriorating. Please consider delaying any non-essential travel. If you must travel, please exercise caution and patience and drive according to road and weather conditions.

Remember - Snow means slow.

#nltraffic

Today in History: December 8 – Key Events That Shaped the World

Major Historical Events

- 1941: The United States formally enters World War II after Congress declares war on Japan following the Pearl Harbor attack. On the same day, Japanese forces launch invasions across Southeast Asia, including Malaya, Thailand, the Philippines, and Hong Kong.
- 1987: President Ronald Reagan and Mikhail Gorbachev sign the historic INF Treaty in Washington, D.C., the first agreement to eliminate an entire class of nuclear weapons.
- 1987: The First Intifada begins in the Palestinian territories after a deadly traffic incident sparks widespread uprising against Israeli occupation.
- 1863: President Abraham Lincoln announces the Proclamation of Amnesty and Reconstruction, laying out his “10 percent plan” for bringing Southern states back into the Union.
- 1991: The Soviet Union officially dissolves as leaders of Russia, Ukraine, and Belarus sign the Belavezha Accords, forming the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS).

Science & Discoveries

- 1864: James Clerk Maxwell presents his groundbreaking paper on electromagnetic theory to the Royal Society, uniting electricity, magnetism, and light.
- 2010: SpaceX makes history as the first private company to successfully launch a spacecraft (Dragon capsule) into orbit and recover it.
- 1961: Seattle’s iconic Space Needle reaches its full height ahead of the 1962 World’s Fair.

Arts, Culture & Society

- 1660: Margaret Hughes becomes the first woman to perform professionally on the English stage, playing Desdemona in Othello.
- 1812: Ludwig van Beethoven conducts the triumphant premiere of his energetic Symphony No. 7 in Vienna.
- 1980: Music legend and former Beatle John Lennon is tragically shot and killed outside his New York City apartment.
- 1854: Pope Pius IX proclaims the Immaculate Conception of the Virgin Mary as official Catholic dogma.

Notable Birthdays

- 1542 – Mary, Queen of Scots
- 1943 – Jim Morrison (The Doors)
- 1953 – Kim Basinger (Oscar-winning actress)
- 1966 – Sinéad O’Connor (Irish singer-songwriter)
- 1982 – Nicki Minaj (global rap superstar)

Remembered on This Day

- 1980 – John Lennon (aged 40)
- 2004 – “Dimebag” Darrell Abbott (Pantera/Damageplan guitarist)
- 2019 – Juice WRLD (rapper, aged 21)
- 1978 – Golda Meir (former Prime Minister of Israel)
